quote: No vehicle in front of the driveway, entrance or approaches to a fire station shall be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction. No vehicle shall use the driveway entrance or approaches to a fire station for the purpose of turning so as to proceed in the opposite direction.

activation.condition: Vehicle reverses direction in front of a station driveway, entrance or approaches, or uses those surfaces for that purpose.

obligation.description: Do not turn to proceed in the opposite direction in the described fire-station region or use the driveway/approaches for that purpose.

timing.description: Entrance-front reversal at the event; driveway-use purpose across entry, reversal and exit.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: in front of the driveway, entrance or approaches to a fire station
judgment_calls_needed.note: Survey mapped public road, station doorway and approach footprints; no legal distance cutoff is supplied.
Retain complete driveway entry, reversal and exit trajectory; purpose remains a human review question.

parameter_refs.name: reversal_location
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: mapped entrance, approach, driveway use or remote public-road reference; physical source survey required
